python3 -c "
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_excel('sales_data.xlsx', header=None, skiprows=1, usecols=[2,3,4,5,6])
df.columns = ['Units','Price','Rev','Cost','Profit']
df['Revenue'] = df.Units * df.Price
df['ProfitCalc'] = df.Revenue - df.Units * df.Cost
df['Margin'] = df.ProfitCalc / df.Revenue
print(df[['Units','Price','Revenue','ProfitCalc','Margin']].to_string())
tot = df[['Revenue','ProfitCalc']].sum()
print('TOTAL Revenue:', tot.Revenue, 'TOTAL Profit:', tot.ProfitCalc, 'TOTAL Margin:', tot.ProfitCalc/tot.Revenue)
"
